description_en: Modifies the configuration of a protection rule
description_zh: 修改防护规则配置信息
name: ModifyDefenseRule

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection rule template.
This parameter is required only when DefenseType is set to template
parameters.help_zh:
防护规则模板ID。
仅当 DefenseType 为 template 时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The protection scenario to be modified. For more information, see the DefenseScene parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的防护场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html的**DefenseScene**参数
parameters.name: defense_scene

parameters.help_en:
The details of the protection rule. The value is a JSON string that consists of multiple parameters. When you configure this parameter, you must specify the rule ID and set the configuration of the protection rule to be modified. The details include:

id: Long | Required | The rule ID.

Protection rule configuration: Same as the Rules parameter of the CreateDefenseRule operation. For more information, see the Protection rule parameter description in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html
parameters.help_zh:
防护规则详情，以一系列参数构造的JSON格式转化成字符串。配置时，您需要指定规则ID，并设置要修改的防护规则配置信息。具体包括：

id：Long类型 | 必选 | 规则ID。

防护规则配置信息：与CreateDefenseRule接口的Rules参数相同。相关描述，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html的**防护规则参数描述**
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run mode. If you do not specify this parameter, a normal request is initiated. Valid values:
true: initiates a dry run request. The system only checks whether the request meets the execution conditions and does not perform the operations specified in the request. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the dry run succeeds, the error code Defense.Control.DryRunOperation is returned.
false: initiates a normal request. The system performs the operations specified in the request after the check succeeds
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启 DryRun 预检模式。如果不输入该参数，表示发起正常请求。取值：
true：表示发起预检请求，仅检查请求是否满足执行条件，不执行请求指定的操作。预检不通过时返回相应错误码；预检通过时返回错误码Defense.Control.DryRunOperation。
false：表示发起正常请求；检查通过后执行请求指定的操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The type of the protection rule
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The protected object to which the modified rule applies.
This parameter is required only when DefenseType is set to resource
parameters.help_zh:
修改规则对应的防护对象。
仅当 DefenseType 为 resource 时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The protection target type. This applies to rules where DefenseType is set to resource. Valid values:

single (default): Single protected object.
group: Protected object group
parameters.help_zh:
防护目标类型。适用于DefenseType 为 resource 的规则。取值：

single（默认）：表示单个防护对象。
group：表示防护组
parameters.name: resource_type
